releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v8.13.0 - UI Streamlining & Unusable Feature Removal:
- Removed non-functional DirectX Desktop Duplication (DDA) Optical Flow Interpolator.
- Removed placebo Resolution & FSR/NIS spatial scaling cards and unnecessary battery popups.
- Cleaned up Gaming & GPU sub-categories into a streamlined, high-performance interface.
- Fully maintained TempTamer 40-50°C idle thermal locking and OptiRouter AI.
